settings.title: Automation
settings.description: Bounded automatic adaptation after a confirmed persistent regression.
settings.adaptiveSynthesis: Automatically create new bypass combinations when DPI behavior changes
settings.adaptiveSynthesisDesc: After a persistent regression, B4X may run bounded active diagnostics, synthesize safe combinations from existing primitives, and evaluate them through the normal Discovery and canary pipeline.
settings.enabledNotice: Adaptive synthesis is enabled. Existing last-good configuration remains active until a synthesized candidate passes ordinary controls, forwarded-client canary, and transactional promotion.
settings.confirmBody: When a persistent regression is confirmed, B4X may run a limited active diagnostic and test newly combined safe techniques. This can take several minutes and temporarily increase router load and test connections. The working configuration remains in place until a candidate passes canary validation.
